commit 44480ad7f32791c6cd0f02573ac88246b8255447
Author:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
AuthorDate: Wed Feb 19 11:33:57 2025 +1300
Commit:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
CommitDate: Wed Feb 19 11:33:57 2025 +1300

    Bug 1949055 - Port bug 1942364: migrate signingscript to autograph gcp production. r=dandarnell
    Port of https://hg.mozilla.org/mozilla-central/rev/0bde2753bf63ed9a86ec1ee2f507fc54467cff31.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D238696

diff --git a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/l10n_source_signing.py b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/l10n_source_signing.py
index c28179f310c..4861e23a4e4 100644
--- a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/l10n_source_signing.py
+++ b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/l10n_source_signing.py
@@ -30,7 +30,7 @@ def define_upstream_artifacts(config, jobs):
                     get_artifact_path(job, "strings_all.tar.zst"),
                     get_artifact_path(job, "l10n-changesets.json"),
                 ],
-                "formats": ["autograph_gpg"],
+                "formats": ["gcp_prod_autograph_gpg"],
             }
         ]
 
diff --git a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/signing.py b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/signing.py
index 297fec0d2e4..3ff257a2c6b 100644
--- a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/signing.py
+++ b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/signing.py
@@ -27,19 +27,21 @@ def remove_widevine(config, jobs):
     This is to avoid adding special cases for handling signed artifacts
     in mozilla-central code. Artifact signature formats are determined in
     gecko_taskgraph.util.signed_artifacts. There's no override mechanism so we
-    remove the autograph_widevine format here.
+    remove the gcp_prod_autograph_widevine format here.
     """
     for job in jobs:
         task = job["task"]
         payload = task["payload"]
 
-        widevine_scope = "project:comm:thunderbird:releng:signing:format:autograph_widevine"
+        widevine_scope = (
+            "project:comm:thunderbird:releng:signing:format:gcp_prod_autograph_widevine"
+        )
         if widevine_scope in task["scopes"]:
             task["scopes"].remove(widevine_scope)
         if "upstreamArtifacts" in payload:
             for artifact in payload["upstreamArtifacts"]:
-                if "autograph_widevine" in artifact.get("formats", []):
-                    artifact["formats"].remove("autograph_widevine")
+                if "gcp_prod_autograph_widevine" in artifact.get("formats", []):
+                    artifact["formats"].remove("gcp_prod_autograph_widevine")
 
         yield job
